mapper.insert: INSERT INTO travel_plans (user_id, title, start_date, end_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{startDate}, #{endDate})

INSERT INTO plan_items (plan_id, day_number, place_name, address, latitude, longitude, visit_order, memo, stay_minutes) VALUES
(#{item.planId}, #{item.dayNumber}, #{item.placeName}, #{item.address}, #{item.latitude}, #{item.longitude}, #{item.visitOrder}, #{item.memo}, #{item.stayMinutes})
mapper.select: SELECT item_id AS itemId, plan_id AS planId, day_number AS dayNumber, place_name AS placeName, address AS address, latitude, longitude, visit_order AS visitOrder, memo, stay_minutes AS stayMinutes FROM plan_items WHERE plan_id = #{planId} ORDER BY day_number ASC, visit_order ASC
SELECT plan_id AS planId, user_id AS userId, title, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate FROM travel_plans WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC, plan_id DESC
